title: Miami World Center Block F-East
address:
150 NE 8th Street
Miami, Florida 33132
United States
description: Block F-East, known locally as the Jewelry Box, is a three-story retail building within the 27-acre Miami Worldcenter development in downtown Miami. Its 135,000 square feet are split between street-level retail on the first two floors and an occupiable rooftop terrace above.
